name: Langtang Valley and Kyanjin Ri
why: The nearest big valley to Kathmandu: up the Langtang Khola gorge past rebuilt Tamang villages to the yak pastures and cheese factory of Kyanjin Gompa, ringed by glaciers.
book: Langtang National Park permit and TIMS card. Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Bus or jeep from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi (7-8 h).
dangers: Landslides and rockfall in the gorge in the monsoon and after quakes.
The 2015 avalanche buried old Langtang village: do not linger under steep slopes after heavy snow.
turnaround: Climb Kyanjin Ri early and be down by noon.

points.name: Syabrubesi
points.note: The road head on the Bhote Koshi, a few hours from the Tibet border.

points.name: Lama Hotel
points.note: Lodges in the forest of the gorge; red pandas live in these woods.

points.name: Langtang village
points.note: A Tamang village rebuilt after the 2015 earthquake, with prayer walls and water-driven prayer wheels.

points.name: Kyanjin Gompa
points.note: A monastery, a cheese factory and lodges at 3,870 m among glaciers.

points.name: Kyanjin Ri
points.note: A 4,773 m viewpoint over Langtang Lirung and its glaciers.
